caseName: Gunderson Bros. Engineering Corp. v. Merritt-Chapman & Scott Corp.
caseNameFull: Gunderson Bros. Engineering Corp. v. Merritt-Chapman & Scott Corp.
attorneys: William F. White for petitioner., Benjamin H. Kizer for respondent.
judges: Amendment, Bros, Constitution, Corp, Granted, Guaranteed, Right, Should, Whether

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Black believe that certiorari should be granted to consider whether the petitioner Gunderson Bros. Engineering Corp. has been denied its right to jury trial guaranteed by the Seventh Amendment to the Constitution of the United States.
